# GroundUp

> GroundUp is an online education platform and community for affordable housing
> development, built by Dr. Gina Merritt of Northern Real Estate Urban Ventures —
> 30+ years and $600M+ of closed deals, from public housing in the Bronx to
> developer and owner. It exists for underrepresented and emerging developers:
> the knowledge, the community, and the resources to get deals done and build
> generational wealth from the ground up.

## What GroundUp teaches
- Predevelopment: reading markets, valuing land, controlling a site
- Building your team: JV partnerships, ownership vs. economic interest
- Financing the deal: capital stacks, LIHTC & tax credits, closing the gap
- Why affordable housing doesn't pencil — and how deals close anyway
- Zoning, entitlements & what you're allowed to build
- Design & construction management
- After opening day: operations, lease-up, and the long game
- New expertise added every quarter

## Membership
- Member ($49.99/mo): every course, written lessons, case studies, worksheets, free live Lunch & Learn invites, community (read)
- Builder ($149.99/mo): everything in Member + posting in the community, the Lunch & Learn recording library, view-only digital products
- Premium ($249.99/mo): + 3 product downloads/month, the Opportunity Board (RFPs & funding windows), JV & Partnerships channel, group office hours with Dr. Merritt, 10% off 1:1 sessions
- Elite ($499.99/mo, limited seats): + direct messages to Dr. Merritt & team, 3 one-on-one advisory calls/year, unlimited downloads including the Developer's Playbook, 30% off 1:1 sessions, private Elite Lounge, networking events
- Also: one-time course passes, Lunch & Learn live-session access, 1:1 paid sessions
  (deal review, strategy, capital stack, community development, BIPOC developer),
  and Senior Advisor retainers for project-embedded consulting

## About the founder
Dr. Gina Merritt — Bronx-raised, from public housing to $600M+ in real estate
development. Founder of Northern Real Estate Urban Ventures (Washington, DC).
Notable projects include 9410 Hough (Cleveland), Nannie Helen (Washington DC),
Parkway House, and Beacon Center DC.

## Who GroundUp is for
People searching for: real estate development education, how to become a real
estate developer, affordable housing development courses, LIHTC training,
tax credit financing explained, capital stack education, first-time developer
resources, BIPOC and underrepresented developer community, women in real estate
development, community development training, underwriting a project budget.

## Ways in
- Free account: browse every course curriculum + one free live Lunch & Learn session
- Course passes: $100 (one course, 60 days) or $250 (all courses, 30 days) — written lessons
- Memberships from $49.99/mo (see Pricing)
- Deep-dive series (e.g. The Underwriting Series) added over time
- Deal-specific support: the Elite membership, 1:1 sessions with Dr. Merritt,
  a $1,500 Full Project Intake (credited toward the retainer), and Senior
  Advisor retainers for whole-deal involvement
- Organizations (agencies, CDFIs, nonprofit developer programs) can sponsor a
  cohort's first year at a group discount with a branded partner page —
  see /partner-interest
